---
description: fight_end as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: ending a fight
arguments:
  fight: "The id of the fight to end; left out, the one fight under way."
  winner: "party or foes: the side that won."
  break_off: "true when the fight is broken off rather than won; no winner is recorded."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Ends a fight, won by a side or broken off, as the world's combat rules end one; no winner is decided unless named. With several fights under way it ends the one named. The answer says what changed and the fights still under way, and lists the world's rules that hear the end without running them.
